scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-core build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/material-palettes build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/ai-gateway build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api-contracts build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/wechat-client build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api build

scripts.openclip:test: uv run --project services/openclip-sidecar --python 3.11 python -m unittest discover -s services/openclip-sidecar/tests -v
scripts.dinov2:test: uv run --project services/dinov2-sidecar --python 3.11 python -m unittest discover -s services/dinov2-sidecar/tests -v

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-core build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/ai-gateway typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/material-palettes typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api-contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/wechat-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api typecheck && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/wechat-miniapp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:api: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api-contracts test && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/wechat-client test && pnpm --filter @ai-bead-pattern/pattern-api test
